plainTranslation: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
summaryDeep: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
